summary: The ownership, license, provenance, attribution, restriction, and correction controls applied to public Aloha AI content, code, datasets, images, marks, and downloads.

policySections.title: What Aloha AI claims
paragraphs: Unless a record says otherwise, original site copy, original frameworks, original code, original interface design, and first-party graphics are claimed by Rayven-Nikkita Collins LLC. That claim does not extend to facts, ideas, legal authorities, government works, third-party marks, quotations, linked materials, open-source dependencies, client material, or another creator’s expression. Publication alone is not proof of registrability, exclusivity, non-infringement, or title.

policySections.title: Provenance before publication
paragraphs: A governed asset records its path or public surface, asset class, source or creator, rights basis, license or permission state, required attribution, restrictions, owner, review date, and change trigger. Binary and vector assets in the checked-in public estate receive a cryptographic hash so replacement or drift reopens review. A link, citation, purchase, download, or AI-assisted workflow is not by itself a license.

policySections.title: Sources, quotations, and datasets
paragraphs: Facts and legal authorities may be cited without claiming ownership of the underlying source. Quoted or adapted expression must remain bounded to an identified purpose and rights basis, with attribution where required. A dataset record must distinguish the data, schema, compilation, transformations, and generated analysis; public availability does not silently authorize collection, redistribution, model training, or commercial reuse.

policySections.title: Marks and third-party names
paragraphs: Names and marks such as Microsoft, Vercel, GitHub, Supabase, Beehiiv, and organizations cited as sources remain the property of their respective owners. Nominative reference or linking does not imply sponsorship, endorsement, partnership, affiliation, or permission to reproduce a logo. No third-party logo is authorized merely because a name appears on the site.

policySections.title: Visitor reuse and downloads
paragraphs: Visitors may read, link to, and make ordinary fair references to public pages. No broader license to copy, republish, sell, train a model on, create derivative products from, or redistribute site content is granted by public access. Browser-generated records are supplied for the visitor’s own review and adaptation, subject to third-party rights in any material the visitor supplies; they do not transfer Aloha AI frameworks, source content, or marks. Commercial, institutional, republication, translation, dataset, and product reuse requires written terms from the relevant rights holder.

policySections.title: Report a rights or attribution concern
paragraphs: Use the current Microsoft Bookings link, choose any available time, and write “rights report — no meeting needed” in the note. Identify the route or asset, the claimed rights holder, the disputed use or missing credit, supporting evidence, requested disposition, when you observed it, and a safe reply address. Do not include credentials or confidential material. A credible report may result in temporary withdrawal while ownership, license, permission, attribution, and affected outputs are reviewed under the Corrections policy.

policySections.title: Public register and limits
paragraphs: The machine-readable inventory at /api/rights-attribution-register.json covers checked-in public image and vector assets plus selected rights classes and third-party references. It is not a copyright registration, chain-of-title opinion, trademark search, repository-wide dependency-license audit, client-material audit, or determination of fair use, public-domain status, non-infringement, or enforceability.

evidence: A hash-based inventory of checked-in public image and vector assets
A rights-class and third-party-reference register with provenance, attribution, restrictions, owner, and review fields
A release-blocking evaluator for inventory coverage, required fields, prohibited inferences, and reporting route
methodology: Classify the material and the expression or data actually used
Record creator, source, rights basis, license or permission, attribution, restrictions, and intended uses
Hash checked-in public visual assets and reopen review on drift
Correct, credit, replace, restrict, license, or withdraw when the evidence does not support publication
